description: A name written with an escape matches no field again, as before the fix
old: EngineCount(p, e, o) == p + (IF KeyRead = "decoded" THEN e ELSE 0)

description: A name is matched by its last piece, so x\u0000id counts as id
old: EngineCount(p, e, o) == p + (IF KeyRead = "decoded" THEN e ELSE 0)
new: EngineCount(p, e, o) == p + e + o

description: A name written twice is not refused
The last of two members wins instead of a refusal
old: EngineView(p, e, o) == ViewOf(EngineCount(p, e, o))
new: EngineView(p, e, o) == IF EngineCount(p, e, o) = 0 THEN "absent" ELSE "value"

description: A field that is absent is reported as true
old: EngineReported == IF engineView = "value" THEN flag ELSE FALSE
new: EngineReported == IF engineView = "value" THEN flag ELSE TRUE
